text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Splendid effort in your mock race, Rhein Kraft! Winning by five lengths was magnificent. Please share your thoughts with us!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: First off——the racing world boasts countless stars. Are there any Umamusume who inspired you to say, "I want to be just like them!"?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Of course, the Umamusume shining on the Triple Tiara path!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Like Mejiro Ramonu-san and Air Groove-san... so awe-inspiring, dignified, and radiant... I truly admire those brilliant seniors!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "Strength"...! If strength is what moves you, surely there are Triple Crown stars you hold in high regard as well?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Such as the legends who took the era by storm, Rudolf-san and Brian-san? When "strength" comes to mind, do those Umamusume not stand out?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, well, yes. That is true, I deeply respect my seniors on the Triple Crown path, but——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Even so, my heart belongs to the Triple Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I-is that so...? Forgive me, but could you elaborate on why...?
The reporter seemed rather puzzled. ...Yet, such a reaction was entirely natural.
Air Groove had claimed victory in the Autumn Tenno Sho, and Hishi Amazon had run toe-to-toe with Narita Brian. However——
"In the Senior Class, whenever Triple Tiara and Triple Crown Umamusume clashed, the former were usually defeated"——
Such was the established reality. Historical race records clearly proved as much.
In Grand Prix showdowns like the Takarazuka Kinen and Arima Kinen, where titans clashed, no Tiara victor had triumphed in over thirty years...
When speaking of sheer "strength," minds inevitably turned to the Triple Crown racers——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: No, they are strong too. The Triple Tiara Umamusume truly possess undeniable strength.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I understand your point completely. I really do. ...That is precisely why I want to prove it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because they are breathtaking, vibrant, and proud, I admire them! That is why I love those who walk the Triple Tiara road!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will claim the Triple Tiara. And once I reach the Senior class, I will challenge the Triple Crown runners.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ——And I will win! I will prove the true might of the Triple Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because they are truly powerful. Those amazing girls... every single one of us!
That sudden tremor struck my chest once more. I remember it clearly. It was no naive idolization——it was genuine conviction.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: T-that is... remarkable. Well, words fail me——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Rather than being at a loss, it feels more like disbelief, right? I suppose my ambition sounds absurd.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, in that case! Will you come interview me again? I will be competing in the upcoming Debut Selection Race.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will prove it right then and there——with a run that makes everyone believe, "She might actually pull it off!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And someday, just as I looked up to my Tiara seniors... even if it starts as a tiny spark of hope and anticipation——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Through my running, one day without fail! I will show everyone what we can do!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! How delightful... She possesses quite the spark, doesn't she? Rhein Kraft, was it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: As a fellow Umamusume targeting the Triple Tiara——keeping a close watch on her seems only fitting, does it not?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...And judging by that sharp glare, I take it you agree? Air Messiah, correct?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Daring Heart-san. To be precise, I have analyzed both of you since learning we share the same Debut Selection Race.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I have already assembled data and formulated countermeasures for you both. Daring Heart-san, and Rhein Kraft-san——

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Along with one other.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Cesario-san! With that stunning final spurt, you secured a decisive win! May we trouble you for a brief comment?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...No. My apologies, but I must take my leave here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: With the Debut Selection Race imminent, my training schedule demands strict focus. ...Now, if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa! Yaaaaaaa—————!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa... Haaaaaa~~...!
From that day forward, Rhein Kraft trained tirelessly. From dawn until just before curfew, pushing herself without rest...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san! You were watching? Ah, come to think of it, did I spot you during the mock race...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah, you really were there? Ehehe~ thank you so much! ...Alright, let me take a brief breather.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Let me show you something special, Trainer-san. The secret behind my boundless motivation!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! My personal treasure collection of "Tiara Race Tapes"! Let's watch them together while taking a break!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, nothing fires me up quite like this! Whenever fatigue hits... or whenever I need focus, I always watch these.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: These historic races overflow with passion, and I feel deeply tied to every stride. ...Alright, starting playback now——!
